# ============================================================================
# BUSIA CHICKEN FARM - ROUTING & SECURITY HARDENING
# ============================================================================

# Set default index file
DirectoryIndex Frontend/index.php index.php index.html

# Prevent directory browsing
Options -Indexes -MultiViews
AddDefaultCharset UTF-8

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    RewriteBase /

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. PHP VULNERABILITY MITIGATIONS (PHP2Shell & CVE-2024-4577)
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Block PHP-CGI Argument Injection (CVE-2024-4577)
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (%ad|%2d|-)[dDsSnpv] [NC,OR]
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (auto_prepend_file|allow_url_include|auto_append_file) [NC,OR]
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} (php:\/\/input|php:\/\/filter|phar:\/\/|data:\/\/) [NC]
    RewriteRule .* - [F,L]

    # Block PHP2Shell multipart session upload progress abuse (CVE-2026-109619)
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Content-Type} multipart/form-data [NC]
    RewriteCond %{HTTP:Cookie} PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS [NC,OR]
    RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS [NC]
    RewriteRule .* - [F,L]

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. APPLICATION ROUTING
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Redirect root to Frontend homepage
    RewriteRule ^$ Frontend/index.php [L]
    RewriteRule ^index\.php$ Frontend/index.php [L]

    # Admin quick shortcut: /admin or /busiaadmin -> /Frontend/admin/login.php
    RewriteRule ^admin/?$ Frontend/admin/login.php [R=302,L]
    RewriteRule ^busiaadmin\.php$ Frontend/admin/login.php [R=302,L]

    # Allow direct access to Backend API
    RewriteRule ^Backend/ - [L]

    # Allow direct access to Frontend
    RewriteRule ^Frontend/ - [L]
</IfModule>

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. BLOCK ACCESS TO SENSITIVE FILES AND FOLDERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
<FilesMatch "(^\.|\.(env|git|gitignore|md|sql|log|bak|conf|ini|sh|yaml|yml))$">
    <IfModule mod_authz_core.c>
        Require all denied
    </IfModule>
    <IfModule !mod_authz_core.c>
        Order allow,deny
        Deny from all
    </IfModule>
</FilesMatch>

# Block access to database config directly
<Files "database.local.php">
    <IfModule mod_authz_core.c>
        Require all denied
    </IfModule>
    <IfModule !mod_authz_core.c>
        Order allow,deny
        Deny from all
    </IfModule>
</Files>

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. HTTP SECURITY HEADERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    Header set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
    Header set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
    Header set X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block"
    Header set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
    Header set Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()"
</IfModule>

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. GZIP COMPRESSION & CACHING
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
    AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/plain text/xml text/css text/javascript application/javascript application/json
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_expires.c>
    ExpiresActive On
    ExpiresByType image/jpg "access plus 1 year"
    ExpiresByType image/jpeg "access plus 1 year"
    ExpiresByType image/gif "access plus 1 year"
    ExpiresByType image/png "access plus 1 year"
    ExpiresByType image/webp "access plus 1 year"
    ExpiresByType text/css "access plus 1 month"
    ExpiresByType application/javascript "access plus 1 month"
    ExpiresByType text/javascript "access plus 1 month"
</IfModule>
